Identified as this saint because: Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), May volume, plate for the 4th, filed by Commons under Category:Pelagia of Tarsus. 4 May is the virgin martyr Pelagia of Tarsus in Cilicia, killed in the Diocletianic persecution in which the bishop Clinon was hunted - the folder's martyr and virgin - as distinct from Pelagia the Penitent of Antioch (8 October) and Pelagia of Tinos.
